newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks open higher than retrace slightly.
newsitem.headline: French stocks open higher than retrace slightly.

text.p: The Paris CAC-40 index of leading shares started on a firmer footing on Friday before slipping back to consolidate below Thursday's close.
Operators believe Paris is on a firming trend, but still lagging, as a bull run continues on other major centres. London opened at a new high.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 3.65 points or 0.18 percent at 2,061.72 at 0821 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was down at 2,067 from 2,070 on Thursday's close.
Total market volume was 720 million francs
Oil group Total ran into profit-taking after hitting a new high on Thursday, with rival Elf Aquitaine following lower.
The oil majors have benefited from the tension over Iraq and high crude prices, particularly Total which has less chemicals exposure than Elf and greater exposure to oil prices and the dollar.
